decision.reason: W1-10 and W2-00 are not GREEN; canonical AIP Task APIs exist but no tenant-safe cross-domain Workshop cockpit view or strict typed blocker projection exists

liveCodeFindings.integrationStage: Asset integration stage is a different lifecycle and must not be merged with Task production stages
